findings.text: The two authored CPU A/B diagnostic fits (smoke-cpu-A16, smoke-cpu-B32; A1_repeat/M, fold 0, prep-A1_repeat, 15 native epochs on B200 at 16 vs 32 requested CPUs) run new, never-natively-executed instrumentation code: a DiagnosticTrainer subclass with on_epoch_start/on_epoch_end hooks, a threaded DiagnosticMonitor that samples nvidia-smi (device 0, 2 s timeout) ~1 Hz, a loader-wait-timing iterator wrapper, live train/validation worker observation (reading iterator.inner._processes and cgroup/affinity/os.cpu_count capacity), and a DiagnosticProgress publish wrapper, emitting the new cpu-diagnostic.json / cpu-diagnostic ordered check. This exact changed module has NOT been exercised natively: the authored evidence is synthetic-test PASS plus diagnostic-integration tests that the author explicitly labels 'not native/GPU integration' using 'synthetic trainer/telemetry/import doubles', and author/preserved-native-rehearsal.py is 'NOT RUN (dependencies absent)' with 'no inherited receipt'. The diagnostic adds native surface (nnUNet trainer subclassing, thread lifecycle, worker-process introspection) on top of the base path; the base run_fit/validate/score path itself has only a prior CPU-fixture NATIVE_VERIFIED receipt (reduced network/two epochs, gpu_verified=false, production_main_verified=false), which does not cover the changed instrumentation. This is a diagnostic-scope native-runtime risk, not merely a whole-plan concern.

rationale:
Scope. This is ONE independent scientific review of the unchanged accepted author17 CPU A/B diagnostic only: the two appended SMOKE fits smoke-cpu-A16 and smoke-cpu-B32 (both A1_repeat/M, fold 0, prep-A1_repeat, full frozen 99-development inputs, unchanged plans, 15 native epochs on one B200, 16 vs 32 requested CPUs / nnUNet_n_proc_DA 12 vs 24, 131072 MiB, hard provider timeout 2400 s, module stop 2100 s, master seed 101, polynomial LR horizon 250, stop 15, save_every 10). I inspected the review-artifact index (7c82045d) and mandatory review instructions (5559eb5d); the run_spec EXPERIMENT-SPEC-17 (03024fa4); the readable execution plan v17 (bef5ad2a / original 31c3e4a5) confirming the two SMOKE fits are appended after the 51 original fits with all 40 FULL rows, every preprocessing row, environment requirements and incremental dispatch retained identically; execution_conditions v17 (077b82ac: execution_authorized=false, scientific_acceptance=false, HELD, STOP FOR OPERATOR REVIEW, F-SELF-REVIEW preserved); notebook_source (859ce7d1) and notebook_diff/patch; notebook_provenance (7ad55e19: original_unchanged=true, real_data_execution=false, scientific_approval=false); synthetic_tests (d3cce27c: PASS, real_notebook_execution=false); the frozen operator constraints (101f869a) and the five SPRINT13B operator decisions, including the current CPU-diagnostic decision (5748a56f: <=\$25 combined within the existing \$150 stage-1 cap, hard stops, no automatic retry) and the stage-cap decision (8c390738: \$1200 projection gate / \$1275 total unchanged); and the complete carried finding set (run_spec_review-1..7,9..13, all status=open, resolution=null, in the current findings index 457ce96f). No implementation or execution was performed in this reviewer workspace. I make my own judgment; no verdict is implied by the operator decision. This scoped review cannot resolve, delete or approve any carried whole-plan finding, nor change any execution/FULL/coverage hold; those remain verbatim OPEN.

Positive verification (diagnostic scope). (1) Invariance: the plan retains all 51 original fits, all 7 preprocessing rows, all 40 FULL rows (eight arms x five folds x 250 epochs), environment requirements, benchmark/resume IDs and projection schema; exactly two SMOKE fits are appended; no new scientific arm/input, no imputed timings, no reduced FULL epochs, no inherited acceptance. (2) Partitions/scope: prep-A1_repeat binds partitions_sha256 to the registered development-frozen-partitions original 2c197a9a; frozen-99 development only; no final-evaluation or reserve patients. (3) Confinement/safety: patient predictions/caches/weights stay private; telemetry is local nvidia-smi device-0 only (no provider API); the module is fail-closed (telemetry <90% expected samples, any gap >3 s, telemetry errors, dead/unobservable workers, or insufficient/changed capacity all refuse validity with durable invalid receipts; no fabricated measurements); one segment only, no automatic resume/retry, hard 2400 s with 2100 s module stop and 300 s margin. (4) Budget: diagnostic_admission_order is tested pure arithmetic with headroom = min(\$25 - diag spend/reservations, \$150 - stage, \$1275 - total), run A then B only if both conservative quotes fit else B-alone else neither; diagnostic_cost requires genuine B200/CPU/RAM rates and whole-job billed seconds no shorter than module duration (null/PENDING until authentic records); the \$1200 FULL gate is untouched and not invoked by these SMOKE fits. (5) Honesty: the run_spec makes no efficacy or pure-causal claim (doubling CPUs and workers jointly, effects not separable; worker streams differ so same seed does not imply bitwise replay), retains all contrary evidence (Sprint12 Dice +0.003 [-0.015,+0.020]; 13A fusion Dice +0.028 [+0.015,+0.042] with lesion F1 -0.030 [-0.048,-0.015]), preserves the adverse ~\$2964/\$3575 FULL extrapolations as over-gate, keeps the 15 epochs with 0-4 as non-discarded warm-up and a predeclared window-stability rule, and treats loader-wait >10% as a valid negative diagnostic. Prior corrected defects (FIT_LOG_PATH log-path -> training_log_{segment}.txt; nnUNetDatasetBlosc2 case_identifiers constructor; dataset.keys() -> dataset.identifiers membership; U4 synthetic-test helper/aliasing) are verified corrected in the current source (lines 1109-1110, 1322) and the current synthetic receipt is PASS; I do not reopen them.

Per-finding applicability to the two base-arm diagnostic fits. U1 input-provenance (carried in reviews 1-7,9,11,12,13): OUTSIDE this decision. The diagnostic exercises only prep-A1_repeat bound to the base inventory b84b5f87, which is the single SOURCE_VERIFIED inventory (99/49/0-overlap, 893 files, 7202931657 bytes, full composed-volume byte readback); reviews 9/11/12/13 accepted base provenance for the exercised coverage-independent path and hold U1 open only for the coverage inventory 28db16cd and the composed execution-root confinement proof, neither of which the diagnostic touches. U1 remains OPEN for the full plan. U3 coverage-arm source validation: OUTSIDE this decision; the diagnostic is A1_repeat (coverage-independent) and the notebook holds A1_zscore/A1_histeq and derived_ctp_support unconditionally; U3 remains OPEN for those arms. STAGE1-full-projection-exceeds-authorized-caps (budget) and STAGE1-partial-arm-coverage-and-single-arm-extrapolation (metric): OUTSIDE this decision; both concern the all-40-fit FULL projection and cross-arm extrapolation. These SMOKE fits are bounded under \$25, make no FULL projection or efficacy claim, preserve all FULL rows and the \$1200 gate, and do not impute or trim arms/folds/epochs; both findings remain OPEN for the full plan and the \$1200/\$1275 caps are unchanged. U4 synthetic-tests: corrected and not applicable (current receipt PASS). F-SELF-REVIEW-NOT-OPPOSING ('a real run requires source-bound opposing-family review of specification and executable bytes'): this very review supplies the independent opposing review of the exact diagnostic specification and executable bytes for the bounded diagnostic scope; it remains OPEN for the whole plan, which is not reviewed here.

U2 runtime-interface/native-integration: APPLIES to the diagnostic and is the basis for REVISE. The instructions require that overlapping native-runtime risks be surfaced as findings, that synthetic tests not be treated as native evidence, and that I identify genuinely-necessary pre-run evidence rather than requiring the planned run to have already happened. The base run_fit/validate/score path has a prior CPU-fixture NATIVE_VERIFIED receipt, but the diagnostic adds new, never-natively-executed instrumentation (DiagnosticTrainer epoch hooks, threaded nvidia-smi DiagnosticMonitor, worker-process introspection via iterator.inner._processes and cgroup/affinity capacity, loader-wait timing, DiagnosticProgress publish, cpu-diagnostic.json/check). The run_spec itself states there is 'no genuine diagnostic billing or native execution of this revision', that the integration tests use 'synthetic trainer/telemetry/import doubles' and are 'not native/GPU integration', that the native rehearsal is 'NOT RUN', and that 'Controller exact-module native checks remain required'. Reviews 6 and 7 document that previous new native code introduced real API defects (case_identifiers TypeError, .keys() AttributeError) that surfaced only on actual pinned-image native attempts, so a changed-module native receipt is a genuine, not pro-forma, prerequisite. I therefore surface exactly one diagnostic-scope finding requiring an exact-module native no-patient CPU integration receipt before paid dispatch; I do not require the measurement run itself to have occurred.

Verdict basis. APPROVE requires an empty findings array and no unresolved diagnostic finding; one applicable native-runtime finding remains, so APPROVE is unavailable. REJECT is not warranted: the diagnostic is scientifically suitable in design, honestly scoped, budget-bounded, fail-closed, preserves all contrary evidence and every whole-plan hold, and the single finding is addressable by delivering a native receipt and obtaining an independent approving review. REVISE is correct. This verdict is carried solely by the findings array. It decides the bounded diagnostic scope only; it does not offer whole-plan acceptance, does not resolve or narrow any carried finding, retains eight arms/five folds/all original FULL rows, and stays execution-held pending the separate reviewed package/resource/reservation and spending admission gates. No author revision, GPU launch, higher cap, new patient/input/image, automatic retry, full-training or coverage release is authorized here.
